funding.supported_assets_note: Card topped up from a Ledger device through the Ledger Wallet (Ledger Live) app: 'Fund your card quickly and easily with BTC, ETH, SOL, stablecoins and more' (Ledger shop page); 'Your crypto will be automatically converted to fiat at the time purchase' (Ledger card page) and 'instant conversion to fiat at the time of purchase' (CL product page). The CL General Terms list the platform assets as BTC, ETH, EURT, XRP, LTC, USDT, USDC, BXX (fiat GBP, EUR, USD); the FAQ adds Solana (receive-only) and says Layer 2 networks are not supported. Crypto deposited on the CL platform is held with 'Bitgo Europe Ltd' (UK/EU Crypto Wallet, General Terms) — the card balance is custodial even though the Ledger wallet is self-custodial → custody modelled as hybrid. Whether conversion happens at top-up (Platform Fees 'Crypto to Fiat 1.75%') or at spend ('Card Spend 2%') is not explained on the pages read → conversion 'unknown'.

changelog.reason: Initial record from 12 official pages read by the unattended research run (Ledger: card page, shop page, US blog 2025-05-28, card-program page; Crypto Life: product page for Ledger, Platform Fees PDF, legal index, General Terms (Monavate version), Monavate cardholder terms (Nov 2023), FAQ, US card page, 2022 launch post; Baanx UK legal index) — single read; second independent read ≥ 24 h later required before publication. Three variants modelled: EEA (EUR, UAB Monavate), UK (GBP, Monavate Ltd / Optimus Cards UK Ltd), US (USD, Cross River Bank — availability contradictory, all fees unknown). Known from official pages: free virtual card, no subscription, 1% cashback in BTC/USDT (2% in BXX), KYC before ordering (Veriff), platform conversion fees 1.75% (crypto→fiat) and 2% ('Card Spend'), card-load and withdrawal fees. UNKNOWN: card FX margin, ATM fee, shipping/delivery and replacement fee amounts, inactivity fee amount, spend/ATM limits, Cryptodraft APR/LTV details (terms unread), US fee schedule — the 'Fee Information Document — CL Card — Monavate' (public.withcl.com and baanxuk.com …-2026.pdf), the page-version Platform Fees, the 2025/2026 Terms of Use, the US Customer Fees page and the Ledger support article could not be fetched (permission not granted / not surfaced by search) → needs_browser_read. Contradictions recorded: country coverage (EEA+UK vs 8-country FAQ list vs 7-region CL list; US 'starting soon' vs 'available'); network Visa (terms, US blog) vs Mastercard logos; cashback 2% BXX present/absent; UK issuer Monavate Ltd vs Optimus Cards UK Ltd; 1.75% vs 2% conversion rows; cardholder terms carry business-card wording.

editorial.summary: Visa debit card from the Crypto Life (CL) platform of Baanx, marketed as the card 'compatible with Ledger' and topped up from a Ledger device through the Ledger Wallet app. EU cards and accounts are operated by UAB Monavate (Lithuania), UK cards by Monavate Ltd (the platform terms also name Optimus Cards UK Ltd), US cards 'in partnership with Cross River Bank'. Free virtual card, physical card free with a $100 top-up (otherwise shipping at an unstated cost), no subscription, 1% cashback in BTC or USDT paid monthly (2% if BXX is chosen), Apple Pay and Google Pay. Crypto-to-fiat conversion is priced at 1.75% and 'Card Spend' at 2% on the platform fee sheet; the card's FX margin, ATM fee and limits sit in a Fee Information Document that could not be read. Available in the EEA and UK; the US, Canada, Switzerland, Brazil and other countries are named inconsistently across the official pages. KYC (Veriff) is required before ordering.
good_for: Ledger device owners in the EEA or UK who want a free card funded directly from the Ledger Wallet app
Users who want cashback paid in BTC or USDT with no subscription
Crypto-backed credit (Cryptodraft/Stableloan, 'rates from 0%') for non-US residents — terms not modelled
not_for: Anyone who needs to know the FX margin or ATM fee before ordering — neither is published on a page the run could read
US residents counting on ordering today: the Ledger page says both 'US starting soon' and 'currently available in … the US'
Spenders who object to a 1.75%–2% crypto conversion charge on top of any FX margin
watch_outs: The card's own fee schedule (Fee Information Document, Monavate) and the 2026 Baanx UK fee PDFs were not readable this run; FX, ATM, delivery and inactivity fees are unknown.
Platform Fees list both 'Crypto to Fiat 1.75%' and 'Card Spend 2%' without saying which applies to a card purchase.

Country coverage differs between the Ledger page hero (EEA, UK), its FAQ (EEA, UK, US, Canada, Switzerland, Colombia, Mexico, Brazil) and the CL product page (EU & Switzerland, UK, Canada, Brazil, Argentina, Australia, US).
Network: the platform terms and the Ledger US blog say Visa; the CL site shows Mastercard logos and the cardholder terms say 'Mastercard/Visa'.
The cardholder terms linked for consumers carry 'Business Debit Card' and 'corporate customer' wording (file dated Nov 2023).
Cashback of 2% is only in BXX (Baanx token); 1% in BTC/USDT is the comparable rate; Cryptodraft-funded purchases earn nothing; no cap published.
Card balances are custodial (Monavate e-money / Bitgo Europe for crypto) and not covered by the FSCS; only the Ledger wallet is self-custodial.
Ledger runs an affiliate programme (affiliate.ledger.com) but nothing read says the CL Card is commissionable.
